title: Sweetgrass Cottage | 30a Vacation Home | 30a Beach Properties – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: An exquisite coastal retreat with six beds and six baths, Sweetgrass Cottage is a rental you don't want to miss out on! Click here to learn more and book a stay of your own.
description_expanded:
Home Highlights:

-Located on Boardwalk F

-Fully renovated

-Private Heated Pool with Outdoor Fireplace

-South of 30a, just east of Paradis & Sugar Shack

-Spacious floorplan for large groups

- Video Tour below under "Floor Plans" Button

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

Luxurious Orleans styled home graces iconic Rosemary Ave in Rosemary Beach. Sweetgrass Cottage is an exquisite coastal retreat. Six bedrooms, 6.5 bathrooms, a private courtyard with oversized pool, and a bonus den space provide plenty of room for the entire family. Enjoy afternoons by the pool or beach, and cozy evenings by the outdoor fireplace- Sweetgrass has it all.

Sweetgrass sits quite stately on Rosemary Avenue- with regal front columns and a grand second-floor, wrap-around porch. Once inside, the main living area is newly updated and comfortable. Light filled windows with double doors lead to an array of balconies and patios. The spacious kitchen offers ample counter space. A large dining table with seating for eight to ten is surrounded by windows overlooking the balcony and trees.

In the open kitchen, a huge, quartz-topped island features an apron sink, four barstools, and two artistic chandeliers. There's a gas range, wall-mounted double oven, spacious refrigerator, wine fridge, microwave, instant hot water, pot filler sink, and coffee bar with Keurig and drip machines. The clean, white cabinets and quartz countertops are accented by a herringbone backsplash. This is an ideal home for two families to share as it features elbow room for all.

The large courtyard features an oversized swimming pool surrounded by cement pavers and seating options. The outdoor fireplace is perfect for cozy nights roasting marshmallows over the flames with a bottle of wine. The sandy beach and excitement of Main Street are both within easy walking distance from your front door.

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:

* Garage Parking for one, parking pad for one

* Several public parking spaces are a few steps away - parking passes are provided

* Private Heated Pool and outdoor fireplace (pool heating $35 p/day)

* 1-2 minute walk to the beach and seconds to the town square

HOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 15)

FIRST FLOOR

* Outdoor COURTYARD with SWIMMING POOL, FIRE PIT, and OUTDOOR SHOWER

* BEDROOM 1: king bed, ensuite bathroom (sleeps 2)

* BEDROOM 2: king bed, ensuite bathroom (sleeps 2)

* BEDROOM 3: king bed, ensuite BATH (Sleeps 2)

SECOND FLOOR

* LIVING ROOM with sofa, armchairs, HDTV, Sonos Sound System

* Open KITCHEN and formal DINING AREA

* WRAP-AROUND COVERED PORCH

* BEDROOM 4: Master with king-bed, ensuite BATH, and BALCONY (Sleeps 2)

* BEDROOM 5: two queen beds, ensuite bathroom (sleeps 4)

* Powder Room

THIRD FLOOR (Ideal for Kids)

* BEDROOM with 1 queen bed, 2 twin beds.

* Office area with desk and print

* Coffee Bar

* Full bath and free-standing bath tun
